content:
The **Harpoon Gun** is a ranged weapon in *Fallout 76*.

## Gameplay[edit]

A handheld, slow-firing, single-shot heavy gun with a high damage output. It has an electrical trigger switch on its grip, similar to the Broadsider. The gun's Harpoon ammunition can be customized to inflict different types of damage on the enemies. All harpoons pin limbs by default in a similar manner to the Railway Rifle.

## Locations[edit]

- Can be found in steamer trunks and level 2-3 locked safes.
- Guaranteed spawn in the wrecked boat north of Point Pleasant beside a dead fisherman along with a Hunting Rifle. On the boat there is also a whale with harpoons sticking out of it.

## Behind the Scenes[edit]

A version of the Harpoon Gun was created for *Nuclear Winter*, however it was never added to the game mode.
